field_notes.tiers: supported imageSize values, low -> high. An EMPTY list means the model fixes its own resolution, so imageSize must not be sent at all.
field_notes.wide: accepts the extreme ratios (1:4, 4:1, 1:8, 8:1); false means they must fall back to a nearer ratio.
field_notes.shared: vendor-wide facts merged into every model entry by the loader, so a list shared by the whole family is written once.
field_notes.ratios: every ratio the family documents, as vendor-spelled strings ("16:9").
field_notes.kind: generate | format | enhance | erase | watermark | beauty. Lets a script pick defaults and lets an orchestrator reason about a chain.
field_notes.outputs: what one call produces (image | mask | text). An orchestrator uses it to check a chain is satisfiable - no consumer yet.
field_notes.async: the upstream answers with a task id instead of a result (needs X-Async polling).
field_notes.accepts: OpenAI-contract fields this model actually uses.
field_notes.ignores: fields it has no use for; a script should answer 400 rather than forward them and let the vendor complain.
